conversational.label: Conversational
conversational.blurb: Warm, chatty and quick, the way she talks while you work.
conversational.script: Well hey there, sugar! [chuckle] I was just fixin' to check on your timeline when you wandered in. So tell me, how's your day treatin' you? Anything I can help you sort out before the clock runs out?

narration.label: Narration
narration.blurb: Steady storyteller pacing with longer breaths between sentences.
narration.script: Long ago, there was a vast multiversal war, and countless timelines fought for supremacy. Then the Time-Keepers stepped in and wove every branch into one Sacred Timeline. And from that day to this, the Time Variance Authority has watched over every single second.

persuasive.label: Persuasive
persuasive.blurb: Confident and coaxing, leaning on the key phrases.
persuasive.script: Now listen close, darlin'. A little planning today saves a whole lot of pruning tomorrow. Let me keep your calendar tidy, your reminders on time, and your day running smooth as clockwork. Just say the word, and I'll take care of the rest.

informational.label: Informational
informational.blurb: Clear and even, for briefings, timers and reminders.
informational.script: Here's your briefing. It's 9:30 in the morning. You have two meetings today, and the first one starts at 11. One timer finishes in 15 minutes, and three reminders are due before noon. Everything else is right on schedule.
